verdict.rationale: Fireworks is an inference and training platform, so background automation is a fair axis, but the evidence shows only building blocks. Batch inference processes large request volumes asynchronously, and tool calling lets developers build their own agents that call APIs and take actions. Neither is a first-class way to set up automations that run on their own. Missing for 10: scheduled or triggered automation jobs, a managed background agent runtime, workflow orchestration and monitoring, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
